A slip: a printed strip showing the card type line and its corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 January 2013 (the PDF was made on 16 April 2013).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-D-lightrepeatingblasterrifle-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Light Repeating Blaster Rifle]]: The game text is reworded: “Use 2 Force to deploy on your warrior. If your power droid or fusion generator present, may target a character, creature or vehicle using 2 Force. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny +1 &gt; defense value. May fire repeatedly for 2 Force each time.” These are the same words as [[Light Repeating Blaster Rifle (Decipher Errata 1998)|Decipher's errata]]. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with a title and a white italic “E”.

The same area of the printed card (scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
